question: What is declared about any mantra equal to this Mṛtyuñjaya mantra, addressed to the twice-born?
premises: By this there is no equal mantra.
This is addressed to the twice-born.
inference: O twice-born, there is no mantra equal to this Mṛtyuñjaya.
plain_english: By this there is no mantra equal, O twice-born; it is Mṛtyuñjaya.
